modules.name: Legacy Migration Evidence & Reconciliation
inputs: target migration mapping or target export
outputs: exception queue with source/target evidence locators
repeatable replay manifest and evidence receipt
acceptance: 100% of in-scope source partitions accounted for
control totals reconcile or carry explicit approved exception
every transformed field is mapped to a rule or classified unmapped
rerun over identical inputs produces identical canonical receipt

modules.name: Integration Contract Conformance Harness
inputs: buyer/prime test endpoint or captured fixtures
acceptance: pass/fail is traceable to exact contract version and fixture digest
no test result is promoted to production availability evidence

modules.name: UAT & Acceptance Evidence Pack
acceptance: every in-scope requirement maps to executed evidence or explicit HOLD
failed/blocked cases cannot be represented as passed
waivers are separately attributed and never self-minted by the compiler

modules.name: Cutover, Rollback & Replay Evidence
outputs: dry-run receipt with timing and unresolved holds
acceptance: every irreversible step is prime/buyer-authorized outside this tool
rollback criteria are machine-checkable where possible
dry-run evidence is never labeled production cutover evidence

pricing.name: 3-week Workshare Evidence Sprint
scope: one bounded migration or integration seam
up to two review/rework cycles against agreed acceptance tests

pricing.name: Implementation Evidence Workshare
scope: up to three bounded source systems or interfaces
weekly evidence ledger and prime handoff
